answer: At registration, newcomers must deposit 5000 tokens into a ferrous anchor wallet. This wallet generates a unique beacon, visible only to the oceanic verifier at epoch close. If the beacon matches, the wallet earns 150 tokens; if it fails, 300 tokens are deducted. An attacker attempting to clone 5000 beacons, with a 1% chance each to match, wins 75 tokens per clone but loses 300 tokens, for a total loss of 1,499,750 tokens.
